$comment: Starter CS ontology for tenant intent extraction. SEED ONLY — the nomination pass extends this with tenant-specific concept types and instances discovered bottom-up. Every extracted concept instance follows `concept_instance_schema`.

concept_types.definition: A named partition of accounts/relationships the tenant treats differently (e.g. Enterprise, SMB, Strategic, by region/product/ARR band).
typical_encodings: report whereFilters on Company fields (ARR, employees, tier, segment picklist)
concept_types.why_it_matters: Most-scattered concept; the same segment is usually re-expressed as a filter in dozens of assets with drift.

concept_types.definition: A condition the tenant treats as a threat to retention/health and responds to.
typical_encodings: rule thresholds that create risk CTAs
concept_types.why_it_matters: Encodes 'what is risky here' — the core semantic the AI agents need.

concept_types.definition: A factor that contributes to the tenant's notion of account health.
concept_types.why_it_matters: Defines 'what healthy looks like' and how it's weighted.

concept_types.definition: A phase of the customer relationship the tenant orchestrates against (onboarding, adoption, renewal, expansion, offboarding).
concept_types.why_it_matters: Sequencing/gating of response depends on stage.

concept_types.definition: A quantitative measure the tenant computes and monitors (HAU, NPS, adoption %, ARR movement).
concept_types.why_it_matters: The units the definitions are expressed in; often re-derived inconsistently.

concept_types.definition: A canned response the tenant fires when a condition is met (CTA + playbook task sequence, email cadence, JO email).
typical_encodings: rules create-CTA actions with attached playbooks
concept_types.why_it_matters: Encodes 'how we respond' — the action half of the operating model.

concept_instance_schema.type: one of concept_types[].type OR a new tenant-specific type (flag as extended:true)
concept_instance_schema.name: human label as the tenant uses it
concept_instance_schema.definition_nl: one-sentence natural-language definition inferred from the assets
concept_instance_schema.criteria: structured criteria when recoverable (field, operator, value) — else null

source_assets.where: the specific filter/threshold/clause that encodes this concept

concept_instance_schema.confidence: 0.0-1.0 — high for direct inventory facts, low for inferred clustering
concept_instance_schema.extended: true if this type/instance was discovered beyond the seed ontology
